You are the implementation owner for GitHub issue #119 in fengie/mhw-mods. Work only on non-UIA/non-secret Heaven Local Bridge hardening.

Rules:
- origin/main canonical; heaven-bridge is relay only. No Remote Desktop Commander.
- Fresh worktree/branch bridge/hardening-v05 from latest origin/main.
- Add bounded wait/poll primitives useful to agents (window/process/file state as appropriate), race-safe desktop handling, structured diagnostics/observability, and regression coverage. Keep results token-efficient and avoid sensitive data.
- Preserve chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2 compatibility and current desktop/code execution actions.
- Audit health/capability reporting and operator TEST gate. Improve docs where needed.
- Do not redesign UIA or credential transport.
- Run python compile, both test suites, PowerShell parsing/operator gate where available, git diff --check.
- Commit/push branch, do NOT merge main yourself.
- Final stdout compactly report branch, commit SHA, changed files, exact test/pass counts, and any conflict risk.
